rows.label: pi
rows.description: constant ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter
rows.hook: has endless decimal digits that never repeat, and fans celebrate it with pies every March

rows.label: Euler's number
rows.description: mathematical constant; limit of (1 + 1/n)^n as n approaches infinity; transcendental number approximately equal 2.718281828

rows.label: golden ratio
rows.description: ratio between two quantities whose sum is at the same ratio to the larger one
rows.hook: is the proportion said to appear in spiral shells, sunflowers and art, written with the letter phi

rows.label: speed of light in vacuum
rows.description: speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum
rows.hook: is the cosmic limit on how fast anything can travel, about 300,000 kilometres every second

rows.label: Planck constant
rows.description: physical constant representing the quantum of action

rows.label: Avogadro constant
rows.description: fundamental physical constant (symbols: L, Nᴀ) representing the molar number of entities

rows.label: Graham's number
rows.description: enormously large number; upper bound solution to a Ramsey theory problem

rows.label: Newtonian gravitational constant
rows.description: physical constant relating the gravitational force between objects to their mass and distance

rows.label: googol
rows.description: large integer number defined as ten raised to the power of 100

rows.label: Boltzmann constant
rows.description: Physical constant relating energy with temperature and other intensive physical quantities

rows.label: googolplex
rows.description: large number defined as ten to the power of one googol

rows.label: fine-structure constant
rows.description: physical constant quantifying the strength of the electromagnetic interaction between elementary charged particles

rows.label: imaginary unit
rows.description: square root of negative one, used to define complex numbers
